videos.title: Install and activate
videos.sub: Install or upgrade the module, and activate your licence.

videos.title: Uninstall and delete
videos.sub: Remove the module, with or without its files.

videos.title: Minimum Quantity
videos.sub: Make customers order at least a set number of units.

videos.title: Maximum Quantity
videos.sub: Stop customers ordering more than a set number of units.

videos.title: Multiples of Quantity
videos.sub: Sell in packs: 3, 6, 9… and choose whether steps start from the minimum.

videos.title: Limit Multiple Quantity
videos.sub: Packs up to a quantity, single units above it.

videos.title: Allowed Quantities
videos.sub: Only let fixed quantities be ordered, such as 6, 12 or 24.

videos.title: Minimum and Maximum Amount
videos.sub: Limit how much a customer must, or may, spend on a product.

videos.title: Amounts include tax
videos.sub: Measure Minimum and Maximum Amount with or without tax.

videos.title: Different products per order
videos.sub: Require, or cap, the number of different products in one order.

videos.title: Auto Save
videos.sub: Save rule table changes straight away, or only with a Save button.

videos.title: Product rules and combinations
videos.sub: A rule for a whole product, or for one size or colour.

videos.title: Category rule
videos.sub: One rule for every product in a category: each on its own, or added up.

videos.title: Brand rule
videos.sub: One rule for every product of a brand.

videos.title: Supplier rule
videos.sub: One rule for every product from a supplier.

videos.title: Customer group rule
videos.sub: Different limits for different customer groups.

videos.title: Global rule
videos.sub: One rule for the whole shop, and a minimum order value.

videos.title: Rule priority order
videos.sub: When a product matches more than one rule, which one wins.

videos.title: Attributes setting
videos.sub: Check a product rule on each combination, or on all combinations together.

videos.title: Status, switching off and bulk actions
videos.sub: See what each rule does right now, and switch or delete many at once.

videos.title: Conditions
videos.sub: Apply a rule only in some situations: price, stock, currency, country…

videos.title: A rule for one customer
videos.sub: Give a single customer their own limit.

videos.title: Rule table filters
videos.sub: Find products fast, and set a product rule for one customer group.

videos.title: Duration: per order, no time limit
videos.sub: The default: every order starts fresh.

videos.title: Duration: active only in a date range
videos.sub: A limit that only applies between two dates, such as a sale.

videos.title: Duration: lifetime total
videos.sub: Count everything a customer has ever ordered.

videos.title: Duration: total in a fixed date range
videos.sub: Add up what a customer orders between two dates.

videos.title: Duration: rolling window
videos.sub: Add up what a customer ordered in the last days, weeks or months.

videos.title: Duration: custom start and length
videos.sub: Count orders from a start date, for a set time.

videos.title: Duration: which order statuses count
videos.sub: Only count past orders in the statuses you choose.

videos.title: Rule templates
videos.sub: Save a set of limits once, and apply it to any product in one pick.

videos.title: Export and import (CSV)
videos.sub: Back up rules, edit many at once in a spreadsheet, or move them to another shop.

videos.title: Blocked attempts log
videos.sub: See every time a rule stopped a customer.

videos.title: Customer messages
videos.sub: Change every message the customer sees, per language, with a live preview.

videos.title: Pack price message and position
videos.sub: The “Pack of 3 for …” line, and where it appears.

videos.title: Product page information
videos.sub: Tell customers the limits before they try to order.

videos.title: Checkout protection
videos.sub: Make sure no order is created while a rule is broken.

videos.title: Custom CSS
videos.sub: Fine-tune how the module looks on your theme.
